queue.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
queue.reason: Cross-sectional PEAD signal conditioned on speaker identity in earnings-call transcripts; mechanism is clear (return engine) but requires speaker-tagged transcript text this system does not ingest, hence data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
queue.reason: Clear ML mechanism combining time-series and cross-sectional momentum from price/return history only, which this system has; classified as return with a defense-like time-series component.

queue.title: Maximum drawdown, recovery, and momentum
queue.reason: Clearly specified price-only cross-sectional signal (drawdown + recovery) with stated monthly/weekly long-short portfolio construction, fully reconstructable from Korean daily price data.

queue.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
queue.reason: Mechanism (value + reversal gated by a price-based regime indicator) is reconstructable from RAWDATA price history and fundamental_merged value fields, though the extreme claimed Sharpe (13) warrants independent re-measurement rather than literature-based trust.

queue.title: Intraday Patterns in the Cross-section of Stock Returns
queue.reason: Signal is defined at intraday (half-hour) granularity across the trading day; this system only has daily OHLCV, so the mechanism cannot be reconstructed without acquiring intraday Korean market data.

queue.title: THEME: Enhancing Thematic Investing with Semantic Stock Representations and Temporal Dynamics
queue.reason: Signal construction depends on NLP semantic embeddings built from text describing investment themes, a data input this system does not currently ingest.

queue.title: The Role of Intangible Investment in Predicting Stock Returns: Six Decades of Evidence
queue.reason: Mechanism is a fundamentals-based factor (R&D/SG&A capitalization) reconstructable from fundamental_merged data with proper reporting lag; not a thoroughly mined classic factor like plain book-to-market, so treated as novel.

queue.title: Learning to Aggregate Zero-Shot LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Classification
queue.reason: Mechanism is clear (supervised aggregator over zero-shot LLM disclosure classifications feeding a signal) but needs a structured corporate-disclosure text corpus and LLM classification pipeline this system does not currently run.

queue.title: Autonomous Market Intelligence: Agentic AI Nowcasting Predicts Stock Returns
queue.reason: Mechanism is clear (agentic LLM daily attractiveness scoring) but depends on real-time web-search-enabled LLM data access from April 2025 onward, which this system's static historical panel (2000-01~) and research harness do not provide.

queue.title: BERT-based Financial Sentiment Index and LSTM-based Stock Return Predictability
queue.reason: Mechanism is clear (BERT text-sentiment index feeding an LSTM return predictor) but requires a financial news/text corpus and NLP sentiment pipeline this system does not have for Korean equities.

queue.title: Trade the Event: Corporate Events Detection for News-Based Event-Driven Trading
queue.reason: Signal mechanism (event detection from news articles driving trading decisions) is clear and would be return-engine, but the system has no news-text corpus or event-extraction pipeline, so it is data_pipeline_required rather than a rejection.

queue.title: Cyber risk and the cross-section of stock returns
queue.reason: Mechanism is clear (text-proximity ML measure of cyber risk sorted into cross-sectional return premium) but requires full disclosure text and a specialized cyber corpus the system doesn't currently ingest.

queue.title: Labor Income Risk and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
queue.reason: The CID construction (dispersion of industry-portfolio returns) and beta-sort portfolio mechanism are both fully reconstructable from RAWDATA return/sector fields already in the system.

queue.title: Supply Chain Propagation of Textual Signals: LLM Embeddings and Cross-Sectional Return Predictability
queue.reason: Mechanism (text embedding + supply-chain graph propagation) is clear but both inputs — disclosure text and a supply-chain network — are absent from this system's current data list.

queue.title: Dynamic Network Risk
queue.reason: Network risk is built entirely from price/return data the system already has, so the mechanism is reconstructable, though the exact connectedness estimator is not fully specified in the truncated abstract (medium confidence).

queue.title: Quantity, Risk, and Return
queue.reason: Uses only trading volume and standard factor-return data already available in RAWDATA; the 'quantity' interaction concept is reconstructable though the abstract leaves the precise quantity measure underspecified (medium confidence).

queue.title: Networks of News and Cross-Sectional Returns
queue.reason: Core input is a massive news-article dataset used to build stock networks; this system has no news-text ingestion pipeline, so the mechanism is clear but not currently reconstructable.

queue.title: Exploiting Supply Chain Interdependencies for Stock Return Prediction: A Full-State Graph Convolutional LSTM
queue.reason: Mechanism (GCN-LSTM over firm supply-chain graph predicting returns) is clear and would be a return-engine factor, but requires customer/supplier linkage data this system does not currently ingest for Korean names.

queue.title: Media abnormal tone, earnings announcements, and the stock market
queue.reason: Clear tone-based event-study mechanism around earnings announcements, but requires media article text data this system does not ingest for Korean issuers.

queue.title: An Exploratory Study of Stock Price Movements from Earnings Calls
queue.reason: Mechanism (earnings-call text to return prediction) is clear but Korean earnings call transcript data is not currently available to this system.

queue.title: Towards Earnings Call and Stock Price Movement
queue.reason: Clear multimodal earnings-call mechanism for return/volatility prediction, but requires transcript/audio data not available for Korean issuers.

queue.title: Anomalous Returns in a Neural Network Equity-Ranking Predictor
queue.reason: Mechanism is a simple, fully reconstructable ANN-on-lagged-quarterly-returns ranking scheme using only price data this system already has; old (2008) paper so confidence is low on effect persistence but testable as-is.

queue.title: SEC Form 13F-HR: Statistical investigation of trading imbalances and profitability analysis
queue.reason: 13F-style institutional imbalance profitability is reconstructable using Korean investor-type (foreign/institution) net-buying flow data as the Korean analog to quarterly 13F holdings changes; testable return factor.

queue.title: Automatic Identification and Classification of Share Buybacks and their Effect on Short-, Mid- and Long-Term Returns
queue.reason: Mechanism (classify buyback announcements, measure short/mid/long-term drift) is clear, but requires buyback-announcement disclosure/classification data not present in system's RAWDATA/fundamental/consensus/flow feeds — data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
queue.reason: Clear NLP-on-disclosure-text mechanism for earnings-day return prediction, but needs an earnings press-release text corpus not currently in the system's data — data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: Do Sell-side Analyst Reports Have Investment Value?
queue.reason: Mechanism is clear (embed full analyst report text, ML-forecast long-term returns, form portfolios) but requires a large analyst-report full-text corpus the system doesn't have — data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: ChatGPT as a Time Capsule: The Limits of Price Discovery
queue.reason: Mechanism needs access to multiple frozen LLM checkpoints with known knowledge cutoffs plus a large matched public-text corpus, neither of which the system has — data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: E-TRENDS: Enhanced LSTM Trend Forecasting for Equities
queue.reason: Mechanism (LSTM next-day trend forecast per stock, rank into portfolio) is reconstructable with Korean daily OHLCV data; testable return signal, abstract mentions market cycles but no explicit crisis/drawdown evidence.

queue.title: The Value of Information from Sell-side Analysts
queue.reason: Same full-report-text dependency as the related sell-side analyst report paper in this batch — needs a text corpus not in the system's data; data_pipeline_required.

queue.title: BreakGPT: Leveraging Large Language Models for Predicting Asset Price Surges
queue.reason: Mechanism (LLM-based time-series forecaster flagging price surges) is reconstructable with Korean daily price/volume data even though exact feature engineering/labeling threshold is underspecified; testable with low confidence.

queue.title: Entropy-Based Financial Asset Pricing
queue.reason: Entropy of each stock's historical return distribution is computable from Korean daily return data as a cross-sectional risk-based factor; testable, with a plausible defensive-characteristic secondary role.

queue.title: Wax and wane of the cross-sectional momentum and contrarian effects: Evidence from the Chinese stock markets
queue.reason: Classic cross-sectional momentum/contrarian study framed as a time-varying risk premium; reconstructable on Korean daily data with rolling CAPM/FF3, though the underlying signal (momentum/contrarian) is already thoroughly mined.

queue.title: A multi-factor market-neutral investment strategy for New York Stock Exchange equities
queue.reason: States a clear cross-sectional multi-factor combination mechanism targeting low market correlation; the feature-combination approach is generic enough to reconstruct faithfully on Korean data.

queue.title: Sparse Portfolio selection via Bayesian Multiple testing
queue.reason: Clear, reconstructable mechanism: rolling k-factor regression plus Bayesian multiple-testing to select a sparse portfolio of statistically significant-alpha names.

queue.title: Cross-sectional Stock Price Prediction using Deep Learning for Actual Investment Management
queue.reason: Clear cross-sectional return-prediction mechanism using standard factor inputs feeding a DL ranking model; reconstructable on Korean universe data with monthly rebalancing.

queue.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Stock Selection

queue.title: Combined machine learning for stock selection strategy based on dynamic weighting methods

reviewer.next_move_reasoning: 세 처방 중 RX3 만 책 수준 기전이 겨냥한 방향으로 움직였고(하락장 베타 1.1549→1.06 · 상승장 베타 0.99 유지 · 상승 포착 1.9042·CAGR 20.53% 무손실 · Calmar 0.3922→0.4121 · 최악 포착 1.25→1.19), 그 실패가 정확히 한 군데로 특정된다 — 개선을 평균 노출 축소(1.00→0.95)로 조달해 짝 기준이 같이 내려갔고(2007 p 0.025→0.075 · 2011 창 기준선 1.00→0.95 뒤집힘) 귀속이 exposure_defense 로 하향됐다. 동시에 2021 창은 그 짝을 넘었다(포착 0.45 · 짝 0.85 · p 0.005) → 배분 성분이 존재한다는 양성 증거가 1건 있다. 노출을 1.00 에 고정한 판에서 같은 기전을 다시 내면 개선분이 전부 기전 방어로 계상되고, 사전등록 지표를 꼬리(최악 포착·CDaR·창별 포착)로 옮기면 효과가 나타나는 자리를 측정한다. R7(stop)을 쓰지 않는 근거: 이 라운드는 '잡음 이내'가 아니라 방향 일관 소득 1건(RX3) + 특정된 기각 1건(RX1 → W2 의 종목축 형태 기각) + 미시행 1건(RX2 → 기전 미발화·축 이탈)이다. 단 A 까지 거리는 크다 — 헌장 §2 의 R 산술(PORT_t 3.938 기준 필요 Calmar 0.528) 대비 최선 Calmar 0.4121, 롤링 36M 44~51%(PORT_t 4.0072 에서의 정확한 필요 Calmar 는 측정 필요).
lessons: 운반(carry)은 점수 축에서 고쳐지지 않는다 — 하방 비대칭 팩터를 결합 점수 1/8 가중으로 넣은 RX1 은 시장 적재(0.99 불변)·하락장 베타(1.1549→1.1411)를 못 움직이고 크기 적재(0.94→0.88)와 MDD 창 선택 성분(+9.3%→−3.1%)만 바꿨다. 운반은 노출·배분 층에서 다루고 점수 축에는 선택 알파의 정의역을 지켜라.

노출을 깎아 얻은 방어는 짝이 같이 내려가 R5 에서 상쇄된다 — RX3 는 하락장 베타 1.1549→1.06 · 최악 포착 1.25→1.19 · Calmar 0.3922→0.4121 을 얻고도 귀속이 exposure_defense 로 하향됐고, 전략 경로가 완전히 동일한 2007 창의 p 가 0.025→0.075 로 사라졌다(짝 1.06→1.02 · 5% 분위 0.95→0.91). 방어 처방은 평균 노출 고정판을 함께 내라.
4개 위기의 중앙값은 꼬리 개선에 둔감하다 — RX3 는 양 극단(1.25→1.19 · 0.60→0.45)을 개선했는데 중앙 포착(0.9529)과 비대칭(1.9982)은 소수 4자리까지 기저와 동일했다. 사전등록 지표는 기전이 움직이는 자리(최악 포착 · CDaR · 창별 포착 · 하락장 베타)로 잡아라.
delta 가 등록한 방향으로 움직였는지 먼저 확인하라 — RX2 는 회전 15.43→17.25 · 비용 2.33→2.60% · 4창 전부 비용 악화로 기전이 발화하지 않았고(버퍼 교체 상쇄가 역전으로 실현) 평균 보유 25.0→43.2종(최대 120종)으로 축도 벗어났다. 기전 미발화·축 이탈은 '기각'이 아니라 '미시험'이다.
next_hypotheses: RX3 노출 고정판 — 상태 조건부 횡단면 재배분을 평균 노출 1.00 에 묶고(현금 축소 0) 시장베타 순위 상·하위 간 비중만 교환한다. 노출 짝 기준이 1.00 에 고정되므로 개선은 전부 기전 방어로 계상되고, 2011 형 미발화 창에서 기준선이 내려가 손해 보는 일(0.99 불변인데 돌파에서 빠짐)도 없어진다.
RX3 상태 변수의 발화 범위 분리 — 2005~2013 완전 미발화(연도별 수익·2007·2011 위기 성분이 기저와 동일)가 확장창 경험분위의 워밍업 때문인지, 추세-지속 상태가 급락형(2011 5개월)을 못 잡는 것인지. 전자라면 보는 창 전반의 증거는 처방 효과가 아니라 침묵이다.
W3 재시험(축 안에서) — 회전 상한을 ≤25종 축에서 다시 재고 지지 조건을 사전등록대로 읽는다(회전↓ · 선택 성분 유지 · 4창 전부 비용 절대값 감소). 이번 판은 회전 15.43→17.25 · 비용 2.33→2.60% 로 기전이 발화하지 않았다.
폭(breadth) 축 단독 시험 — RX2 가 우연히 건드린 축(평균 보유 25.0→43.2 · 유효 23.9→25.0)이 MDD 창 초과 −3.8→+0.5%(선택 9.3→15.3%)와 롤링 36M 45→51% 의 원인인지. 정체 관문을 움직인 유일한 관측이므로 회전 축과 섞지 말고 단독으로 재야 한다.
RX3 의 2015 참여 손실(39.5→30.4% · −9.1%p) 출처 — 강세 구간 오발화라면 상태 해제 조건을 다듬는 것이 노출 고정판보다 먼저다.
